<div class="card-body">
'''Lucky Shot''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ラッキー・ショット</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">戦闘用ビークルを目標として起動している場合に、武器運命数にXを加える。実際に武器運命数を引く前に使用すること。ユーズド：X＝1。ロスト：X＝3。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Lucky-Shot-PSA-91317477.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">AT－ATの装甲に歩兵用火器は通用しないが、ごく稀にブラスターの光弾が装甲板の隙間を貫くこともある。非常に分の悪い賭だが、反乱軍にとってはいつものことだ。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Lucky Shot.

'''Card text:'''
When activating a weapon targeting a combat vehicle, add X to the weapon destiny. Use this before the weapon destiny is drawn. Used: X equals 1. Lost: X equals 3.

'''Lore:'''
Infantry weapons cannot pierce AT-AT armor, but a blaster bolt rarely hits a gap in the plating. It is a very poor bet, but such odds are nothing new for the Rebellion.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Game text uses 起動する for targeting and writes USED/LOST as ユーズド／ロスト.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Lucky Shot]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
